scholarships.name: Kaplan Early Bird Scholarship
scholarships.description: Early-bird discount applied automatically when you pay the deposit at least 90 days before the start of your Kaplan pathway course (Foundation or Pre-Master's).

scholarships.name: Kaplan Academic Achievement Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for top-performing applicants on Kaplan pathway programmes. Awarded after academic review of transcripts.

scholarships.name: University of Liverpool Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awarded to high-achieving international students entering undergraduate or postgraduate study at the University of Liverpool. Automatic consideration after firm acceptance.

accommodation.name: Life in halls
accommodation.text: Find out about life in our halls, with information on everything from inductions and events, getting around, available support and how to get involved.

accommodation.name: Greenbank Student Village
accommodation.text: Hands down our best hall for first years with beautiful, modern accommodation, stunning parkland, and fabulous facilities, it is the ideal place to start your University life.

accommodation.name: Dover Court
accommodation.text: Dover Court is located just to the north of the University's city centre campus, and offers self-catered, en-suite accommodation.

accommodation.name: Philharmonic Court
accommodation.text: Philharmonic Court offers self-catered en-suite rooms for students, all with double beds, arranged round a private central courtyard, with a 24 hour reception.

accommodation.name: Vine Court
accommodation.text: Located on the University's city centre campus, Vine Court offers self-catered and catered accommodation.

campuses.title: Liverpool Main Campus
campuses.text: Компактный городской кампус в центре Ливерпуля — между двумя соборами и доками Albert Dock. Знаменитое здание Victoria Building (родоначальник термина «red brick university»), школы медицины, инженерии и искусств.

campuses.title: London Campus
campuses.text: Постдипломный кампус в Финсбери, Лондон — программы Management School (MBA, финансы, аналитика). Полноценный диплом Ливерпуля с возможностью учиться в столице Великобритании.

campuses.title: Suzhou (XJTLU)
campuses.text: Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University — совместный кампус с китайским университетом в городе Сучжоу. Студенты получают двойные дипломы (Ливерпуль + XJTLU) с возможностью провести год обмена в Великобритании.

paragraphs: A highly ranked university with a vibrant city-centre campus and world-class teaching delivered by leading experts. Liverpool is known for its academic excellence.
New fast-track study option! Study an IYO in Law at Kaplan International College London and progress to Year 2 of your University of Liverpool degree.
Liverpool is well respected for many of its degrees, so you know you’re getting a great education that will impress employers.
The University has adopted the same international and cultural diversity as the city itself. Liverpool thrives off its multicultural community.
